class.name: CgameSaveMigrations
class.brief_description: Registry of versioned, single-step save-data migrations.
class.description: [CgameSaveMigrations] holds migration steps [code]{from_version, to_version, migrate}[/code]. [method migrate] walks the chain from the save's [code]version[/code] to the target version. It never mutates the caller's dictionary and refuses gaps, downgrades and saves without a numeric version, reporting the reason in [member last_error]. [method verify_roundtrip] proves that a sample survives migration and still passes a validator, so every schema bump can ship with a fixture. A migration callable receives a [Dictionary] (already a deep copy that it may mutate) and returns the upgraded dictionary without touching [code]version[/code]; the runner stamps it. Steps must advance exactly one version and must be pure. [method character_registry] returns a registry with two example character migrations: version 2 renames [code]money[/code] to [code]silver[/code] and version 3 adds a [code]focus[/code] meter defaulting to [code]100.0[/code].

method.name: character_registry
method.description: Returns a registry preloaded with the example version 1 to 3 character migrations.

method.name: register
method.description: Adds a step. Returns [code]false[/code] and sets [member last_error] if the step does not advance exactly one version, the source version is already registered or the callable is invalid.

method.name: migrate
method.description: Returns the migrated deep copy, or an empty dictionary with [member last_error] set (gap, downgrade, missing version or a step that did not return a dictionary).

method.name: verify_roundtrip
method.description: Returns the problems found (empty means ok): migration failure, mutated input, wrong final version, validator rejection, or a second [method migrate] call that is not a no-op. The optional validator receives the migrated data and returns a [bool], a [String] or an [Array] of messages.

method.name: example_v1_to_v2
method.description: Example step: renames [code]money[/code] to [code]silver[/code]; an existing [code]silver[/code] wins.

method.name: example_v2_to_v3
method.description: Example step: adds [code]focus[/code] with the value [code]100.0[/code] when absent.

members.member: Reason the last [method register] or [method migrate] call failed. Empty after a successful migration.

constants.constant: Latest version of the example character save.
